title: Is Your LLM Relay Serving What It Claims? A low-cost and high-power test for LLM Relay Auditing
abstract: arXiv:2610.37086v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Relay and reseller APIs have become a common way to access large language models (LLMs), yet users cannot directly verify whether they receive the models they request and pay for. This opacity motivates LLM relay auditing, but existing methods struggle to combine low cost, robustness to benign deployment changes, and statistically interpretable decisions under black-box access. To address these limitations, we propose distributional fingerprint auditing (DFA), a statistical method that requires only textual responses from suspect and trusted reference endpoints. DFA repeatedly queries semantically simple finite-choice probes and uses the resulting categorical response distributions to construct endpoint fingerprints. It compares the suspect and reference fingerprints probe by probe and aggregates the resulting evidence using the Cauchy combination test, yielding an approximate endpoint-level $p$-value for audit decisions at a prespecif

translated_title: 你的大模型中转服务名副其实吗？一种用于LLM中转服务审计的低成本、高功效检验方法
translated_abstract: 中转和转售API已成为访问大型语言模型（LLM）的常见方式，然而用户无法直接验证自己是否确实收到了所请求并付费的模型。这种不透明性催生了LLM中转服务审计的需求，但在黑盒访问条件下，现有方法难以同时实现低成本、对良性部署变化的鲁棒性以及统计上可解释的决策。为解决这些局限，我们提出了分布式指纹审计，这是一种仅需要可疑端点和可信参考端点的文本响应即可工作的统计方法。DFA反复查询语义简单的有限选项探针，利用由此产生的类别型响应分布构建端点指纹，并逐探针比较可疑端点与参考端点的指纹，再使用柯西组合检验聚合证据，从而在预先指定的显著性水平下产生用于审计决策的近似端点级p值。
tldr: 提出分布式指纹审计方法DFA，通过反复查询简单的有限选项探针构建端点指纹并利用柯西组合检验聚合证据生成端点级p值，实现了低成本、鲁棒且统计可解释的LLM中转服务审计。
en_tdlr: Proposes Distributional Fingerprint Auditing (DFA), which builds endpoint fingerprints by repeatedly probing with simple finite-choice questions and aggregates evidence via the Cauchy combination test, enabling low-cost, robust, and statistically interpretable auditing of LLM relay services.
